# Banknote Expert

> Free, client-side tools to check US banknote serial numbers for collectible
> "fancy" patterns, star notes and value. No account, no upload, every
> calculation runs in your browser.

Site: https://www.banknoteexpert.com/

## About

Banknote Expert helps collectors and owners of US paper money inspect a
banknote's serial number. Enter a serial and the tools report whether it matches
a fancy pattern collectors seek, whether it is a scarce star note, and what such
a note may be worth. All logic is static and runs client-side; the site stores
no serial-check data and never transmits the serial numbers you enter. Optional
comments use a separate server-backed comment service.

## Tools and guides

1. Fancy Serial Number Checker, https://www.banknoteexpert.com/
   Enter any US banknote serial. Detects radar, solid, ladder, repeater, binary,
   low/high serial, birthday and more; returns a 0–100 rarity score and an
   estimated value range.
2. Star Note Lookup, https://www.banknoteexpert.com/star-note-lookup/
   Enter a star note's denomination, series and serial. Matches it against BEP
   print-run data, reports the run size and rarity tier, and flags any fancy
   pattern.
3. $2 Bill Serial Number Lookup, https://www.banknoteexpert.com/2-dollar-bill-serial-number-lookup/
   Enter a $2 note's series and serial. Reports seal colour and note type, flags
   fancy patterns and stars, and gives a value range.
4. Fancy Serial Number Price Guide, https://www.banknoteexpert.com/fancy-serial-number-value/
   A value chart by pattern and condition, with confidence ratings and sources.

- Fancy serial numbers overview (hub): https://www.banknoteexpert.com/fancy-serial-numbers/
- Radar serial numbers: https://www.banknoteexpert.com/fancy-serial-numbers/radar/

- Low serial numbers: https://www.banknoteexpert.com/fancy-serial-numbers/low-serial-number/
- Birthday notes: https://www.banknoteexpert.com/fancy-serial-numbers/birthday-note/
- Where is the serial number on a dollar bill: https://www.banknoteexpert.com/where-is-the-serial-number-on-a-dollar-bill/

Other patterns, binary, solid, repeater, super radar, seven-of-a-kind, double
quad, trinary, high serial and flipper, are explained as sections on the hub
page at /fancy-serial-numbers/.

## Notes for automated agents

- Public content pages are statically rendered and crawlable.
- Tools have no login or paywall. Some pages include moderated user comments.
- Serial number checks are deterministic; the same input always yields the same result.
- Value ranges use recorded sold-price samples. Small samples are marked indicative;
  combinations with no recorded sales have no value estimate. Star-note print-run
  information is based on BEP production data.
